descripcion.es: MoonDesk es una plataforma para gestionar y aprobar artes de packaging. Diseñé su comunicación digital: carruseles y posteos para redes, ebooks y one-pagers comerciales, con un estilo ilustrado que explica el producto a partir de historias simples.
descripcion.en: MoonDesk is a platform to manage and approve packaging artwork. I designed its digital communication: social carousels and posts, ebooks and sales one-pagers, with an illustrated style that explains the product through simple stories.
